Title: The Frenchman, the Female, and the Man Called Mother's Milk
Writer: Anslem Richardson, Garth Ennis, Darick Robertson
Actors: Karl Urban, Jack Quaid, Antony Starr
Plot: Butcher, Hughie, Mother's Milk, and Annie break into Vought Studios, where Butcher and Hughie get caught. Frenchie tries using radiation on Kimiko to replicate Soldier Boy's abilities but fails. Homelander dissolves the Seven.
